sourceNotes.rawContent:
A dreamy pastel gift hamper made for your favourite person — perfect for Friendship Day, birthdays, or just to say "you are my best friend." A mix of everyday jewellery pieces she can wear on repeat, paired with cute quote cards.
What's Inside:
- Morchadi Jewels Pearl Beaded Chain Necklace
- Morchadi Jewels Stud & Hoop Earrings Set (6 Pairs – Gold Tone)
- Peach & Pearl Beaded Flower Charm Bracelet
- Gold-Tone Twisted Ring
- Satin Scrunchie – Ivory Rose
Why She'll Love It:
- A complete jewellery set — necklace, 6 earring pairs, bracelet & ring in one box
- Soft, wearable everyday pieces in a cohesive gold & pastel palette
- Perfect for Friendship Day, birthdays, or a "thinking of you" surprise
Note: Cash on Delivery (COD) is not available for this hamper. Prepaid orders only.
